notablePrerequisites: Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.
